messages.content: You are a precise biomedical information extraction assistant. Follow the requested output format exactly and never add explanations.

Find duplicate entities for the item and an alias that best represents the duplicates. Duplicates are those that are the same in meaning, such as with variation in tense, plural form, stem form, case, abbreviation, shorthand. Return an empty list if there are none.

item: "people who are suicidal or prone to addiction"
set: ["people who are suicidal or prone to addiction", "drug addiction or suicidal thoughts", "people who are not suitable for surgery", "avoid being near people who are sick or have an infection", "suicidal thoughts in young people", "tell doctor about history of drug addiction or suicidal thoughts", "addiction", "alcoholism or drug addiction", "suicidal behaviour or ideation", "suicidal thoughts or actions", "risk of suicidal thoughts in young people", "may increase suicidal thoughts in young people", "these effects are not a sign of addiction", "drug addiction", "alcohol addiction", "most people are told to eat more potassium"]

Respond with a JSON object with exactly these fields:
  "duplicates": list of exact matches to items in the entities set that are duplicates of the item
  "alias": best entity name to represent the duplicates, ideally from the entities set
